item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 17/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. A broad band of clouds is expected to cover southern China midweek this week, there will be a few showers over the region. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be hot over Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches at first.

PSR: Low
